prose: Artificial Analysis has benchmarked StepFun's Step 5 Preview, a proprietary reasoning model released in September 2026, and places it among the leading models on its Intelligence Index with a score of 44, well above the comparable-model median of 24. It supports text and image input with a 1M-token context window and runs faster than average at 100 output tokens per second.

The trade-offs are clear: the model is very verbose, burning 160M tokens across the Intelligence Index versus a 92M median, but it is priced aggressively at $1.00 per million input tokens (median $1.88) and $2.70 per million output tokens (median $10.00), making the full evaluation cost $922.84. The index covers ten evaluations including Terminal-Bench 4.0, SciCode, Humanity's Last Exam and GDPval-AA.
highlights: Step 5 Preview scores 44 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index vs a median of 24 for comparable models.
Pricing: $1.00/1M input and $2.70/1M output tokens, well under medians of $1.88 and $10.00.
Faster than average: 100 output tokens/second vs a 70 median.
Very verbose: 160M tokens generated across the Intelligence Index vs a 92M median.
1M-token context window; text and image input, text output; proprietary model from StepFun, released September 2026.
Index v4.3.2 spans 10 evals incl. Terminal-Bench 4.0, SciCode, Humanity's Last Exam, GDPval-AA, AA-Omniscience.
